description:
This process begins when a customer places an order through an online platform or over the phone.
The system automatically generates an order confirmation and sends it to the customer.
The warehouse team picks and packs the items, and a shipping label is generated.
The order is then handed over to a logistics provider for delivery.
Tracking information is sent to the customer.
The process continues as the shipment is monitored until it reaches the customer's address.
After successful delivery, the process ends, but customer feedback or returns may trigger further actions.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_OrderFulfillment"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-fulfillment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Customer order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderHandover" name="Order for delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Customer feedback or return"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Customer places order online or by phone">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderReceived" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateConfirmation" name="Generate order confirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Send order confirmation to customer" messageRef="Message_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PickItems" name="Pick items"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackItems" name="Pack items"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" name="Generate shipping label"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_HandOverOrder" name="Hand over order to logistics provider" messageRef="Message_OrderHandover"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTracking" name="Send tracking information to customer" messageRef="Message_TrackingInformation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorShipment" name="Monitor shipment until it reaches the customer’s address"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Delivered" name="Successfully delivered to customer’s address"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubProcess_PostDelivery" name="Further actions after customer feedback or return" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Customer feedback or return received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_FeedbackOrReturn" messageRef="Message_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeFurtherAction" name="Take further action"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FurtherAction" name="Further action completed"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FurtherAction_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn" targetRef="Task_TakeFurtherAction"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FurtherAction_2" sourceRef="Task_TakeFurtherAction" targetRef="EndEvent_FurtherAction"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_2" sourceRef="Task_GenerateConfirmation" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_3" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_PickItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_4" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_PackItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_5" sourceRef="Task_PackItems" targetRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_6" sourceRef="Task_GenerateShippingLabel" targetRef="Task_HandOverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_7" sourceRef="Task_HandOverOrder" targetRef="Task_SendTracking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_8" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Task_MonitorShipment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_9" sourceRef="Task_MonitorShipment" targetRef="EndEvent_Delivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OrderFulfillment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OrderFulfillment" name="Order fulfillment" processRef="Process_OrderFulfillment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LogisticsProvider" name="Logistics provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CustomerOrder" name="Customer order" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderHandover" name="Order for delivery" sourceRef="Task_HandOverOrder" targetRef="Participant_LogisticsProvider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TrackingInformation" name="Tracking information" sourceRef="Task_SendTracking" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FeedbackOrReturn" name="Customer feedback or return" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_FeedbackOrReturn"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
